about_the_game:
Whacky committed a crime and received his sentence: to wander through the strange, hilarious, and often contradictory chapters of human history.

This darkly comedic 3D platformer reinvents itself with every chapter. No two worlds play the same — one may test your precision and balance, another your logic or timing, and the next your ability to adapt when reason stops working. You’ll build, climb, push, break, sneak, debate, escape, and question. Every level reshapes the rules, forcing Whacky to learn how absurd survival can be when the laws of both physics and society are unreliable.

Each world parodies a different fragment of civilization — the systems we obey, the ideas we repeat, the illusions we refuse to let die. One moment feels like a puzzle, the next like an experiment gone wrong. Whether you’re assembling, rescuing, running, or just trying not to fall apart, the real challenge is recognizing yourself in the chaos.

FEATURES

  • A narrative-driven 3D platformer with dark humor and surreal world design.

  • Constantly evolving gameplay: new mechanics, tools, and challenges in every chapter.

  • Physics-based interactions, environmental puzzles, and exploration-driven storytelling.

  • A mix of satire, philosophy, and absurd comedy — equal parts silly and unsettling.

  • Worlds designed to feel both familiar and disturbingly absurd

  • A constantly shifting tone that mirrors the chaos and creativity of human history.

  • Absurd rules, twisted systems, unexpected truths — and now, they’re all yours to stumble through.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains dark humor, violence, and satirical themes related to human behavior and history. Some scenes include blood effects and exaggerated representations of death or chaos, often presented in an absurd or comedic context. There is no explicit sexual content, drug use, or self-harm.

name: WHACKY

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Whacky committed a crime and was punished for it. Now he must stumble through humanity’s most idiotic moments — because no cosmic punishment is crueler than living among humans.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Turkish*
*languages with full audio support
